title: Tournament Registration Form
subtitle: Capture division placement, roster, schedule, and rules acknowledgment; confirm credential and result route.
description: Tournament Registration records division placement, roster, schedule, rules acknowledgment, credential, and result route. Tournament Registration evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this tournament registration registration and placement when staff must document division placement and roster. Reconcile schedule, rules acknowledgment, credential, and result route before the tournament registration handoff. Use the entry application, eligibility source, roster and substitutes, division capacity, schedule acknowledgment, rules receipt, credential record, and placement notice. This registration places a team or entrant into a competitive division using eligibility, roster and substitutes, seeding inputs, bracket capacity, rules receipt, and credential issue. Capture team-manager authority, age or weight classification where applicable, roster lock, jersey or bib assignment, club affiliation, ranking evidence, and officials' packet readiness. Ask the assigned tournament registration reviewer to confirm division placement against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Tournament Registration registrant details review
sections.guidance: Confirm division eligibility, roster and substitutes, schedule availability, rules receipt, credential issuance, seeding source, payment reference, and result route.

sections.title: Tournament Registration decision: requested options and readiness
sections.guidance: Record requested options, prerequisites, availability, and conditions without assuming an outcome.

blocks.label: Tournament Registration readiness
items: Division placement is identified for this record
Roster matches the current request or source
Schedule is ready for point-of-use staff
Rules acknowledgment limits or questions are resolved
Credential is communicated to the responsible person
Result route is confirmed at handoff

sections.title: Tournament Registration exception review: confirmation and next steps
sections.guidance: Confirm the accepted scope, reference, open condition, and instructions.

blocks.label: Tournament Registration receipt

fields.label: Event coordinator or responsible staff and date

blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms the recorded registration result and open condition.
